coverageGaps: This is a selective operation-family crosswalk, not an exhaustive specification or a parity percentage.
File censuses do not enumerate capabilities. Includes, generated OpenAPI/schema, translations, examples and cross-links need operation-level extraction.
Separate-repository temporal snapshots can include future or absent features. Bind each requirement to release, edition and original execution before acceptance.
Every n8n service node version, operation, credential type and paid/cloud feature remains to be inventoried.
Excalidraw props, methods, options, defaults, element attributes, actions and gestures are grouped rather than fully enumerated. Hosted collaboration and Excalidraw+ are not pinned.
Every option in 36 pinned Node-RED English node-help files, runtime/admin API and configuration surface still requires enumeration.
Component-study reconstructions are not full-product oracles and do not prove that these original applications inherit studied behavior.

No listed capability has passed a complete original-product parity suite. Comparative speed, reliability, security, accessibility, compatibility, functionality and resource-cost improvements remain unestablished.

reproduction.releaseMapping: GET version-specific registry URLs; compare direct dependencies, resolve stated Git tags through git/ref/tags and retain exact commits.
reproduction.documentationSnapshot: For independent docs repositories, GET /repos/{repo}/commits?until={releasePublishedAt}&per_page=1. This selection establishes temporal provenance, not exact release feature binding.
reproduction.sourceHashes: GET each source URL and SHA-256 its UTF-8 body. Require HTTP 200.
reproduction.fileCensus: GET each inventory API URL; require truncated=false; filter blob paths by pathRegex, sort, and SHA-256 UTF-8 JSON.stringify(paths). Counts are file counts, not verified capabilities.
reproduction.nextStep: Acquire complete pinned products, extract every documented option/operation into keyed requirements, and create original-product fixtures before recording parity or improvements.
reproduction.originalFormatSubset: node products/rea-studio/apps/sketch/vendor-oracle.mjs; verifies preserved released archive/bundle hashes and uses isolated unchanged helpers only. A skipped original oracle is not compatibility evidence.
